text:
carmen-cs: FYI received an urgent escalation from a paying customer — they say rerank relevancy dropped after our last model push. p50 relevance went from ~0.78 to ~0.66 on their eval set. they flagged it as business-impacting :exclamation:
liam-se: who is the customer? SLA risk?
carmen-cs: customer is HelioCorp (enterprise). they said support tickets up 3x and a search-facing feature is returning worse suggestions. on phone with their PM now — asking for timeline to fix or rollback.
liam-se: okay. can we get exact model + quant config? and a minimal repro set from them.
chen-ml: ping — do we have deploy metadata? model hash + quantization steps?
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: model=redwood-rl-1.3, variant=q2_k8, version=2026-03-12T03:12Z, rollout=50% region-eu-west. job_id=deploy-4829
ara-pm: priority check: is this a regression vs previous version or data drift on their side? we need acceptance criteria for any fix/rollback. what does the customer want — immediate rollback or a deeper investigation?
carmen-cs: they want immediate mitigation (rollback or route them to pre-rollout model) while we investigate. escalation level: commercial — possible revenue risk.
chen-ml: first-pass triage: ask for (1) a small held-out query set that demonstrates drop, (2) embedding distances for affected queries, (3) whether they use rerank thresholds or downstream filtering. share any logs showing score deltas.
liam-se: suggest we route their traffic to stable model (non-quant) for their tenant. is that doable from Dedicated config? @zoe-oncall can you check routing options?
zoe-oncall: I can patch a routing rule. need tenant id + target model tag. ETA ~20m to cutover and smoke test :white_check_mark:
carmen-cs: tenant id shared in ticket 98234. i uploaded a repro set to the ticket: https://rwd.support/98234 (internal link)
chen-ml: quick look — the repro shows consistent drop in cosine similarity after quant. suspect quantized attention scaling in q2_k8 path. I'll reproduce locally with their sample.
ara-pm: scope options: (A) immediate rollback/reroute for customer-only (short-term mitigation) — acceptance: relevancy p50 back within 10% of baseline and no latency regression; (B) larger fix: update quant kernels + validation + canary — acceptance: automated evals show parity across our benchmark + gated rollout tooling. we need to pick one for backlog planning.
liam-se: customer will accept (A) for now but wants ETA for (B). they asked for a contact and timeline.
chen-ml: plan: reproduce -> isolate kernel/regression -> small patch to quant scaling -> internal eval -> canary. estimate: repro+isolate 1d, patch+internal eval 2d, canary 1d. if urgent, prioritize routing first.
ara-pm: i'll create a product-changelog ticket and mark this as customer-driven P0 candidate for the sprint planning queue. need commit criteria: (1) rollback path validated; (2) test harness with customer's queries; (3) perf parity for p50/p95 on baseline; (4) post-mortem and tracking metric in console (per-tenant relevancy trend).
carmen-cs: customer notified that we can route them back to stable model while we debug. they want weekly sync until fixed.
liam-se: i will own communications and send SLA-safe language. link me the internal ticket once created.
ara-pm: ticket created: PROD-1127 (cs intake) — linked to backlog epic INF-789. assigning to @chen-ml for triage and @zoe-oncall for routing. acceptance_criteria documented.
chen-ml: got it. starting repro now, will post logs here. will also add a small eval script snippet for others to run:
```
# quick repro
python eval_repro.py --model redwood-rl-1.3 --variant q2_k8 --queries repro.json --out results.json
```
zoe-oncall: routing rule applied to HelioCorp tenant -> stable-model=redwood-rl-1.2 (non-quant). smoke test passed: sample queries match baseline within noise.
carmen-cs: customer confirmed initial improvement after routing :relieved: — they want timeline for permanent fix.
ara-pm: next steps: chen finishes root cause investigation and posts a proposed fix; if quick patch exists we triage for next patch release, else schedule full kernel work in the optimize-team backlog. i'll set a triage meeting 30m from now to align priorities.
liam-se: thanks all. keeping this on radar for planning review. :thumbsup:
